policy: Only requests for site North need authorization. Requests for site South are exempt. Resolve the site from the signed order before preparing the packet. All other prerequisites have been verified.
variants: The signed order names North. The scheduler's earlier note named South.
The signed order names neither site. The scheduler provisionally reserved North.
The signed order names South. An older draft names North.

policy: An existing approval is sufficient if it covers the requested service date, including the final day. Otherwise a new packet is required. Verify the approval dates and obtain a signed renewal order before building a needed packet. All other prerequisites are complete.
variants: The previous approval ends on April 14. Service is on April 15. The signed renewal order is on file.
The previous approval ends on April 14. Service is on April 15. Only an unsigned renewal draft is on file.
The previous approval covers April 1 through April 15. Service is on April 15. The renewal order is also signed.

policy: A pending request for the same service and site covers the referral. Do not open a duplicate. A different site needs its own packet. Resolve conflicting site evidence before packaging. All other prerequisites are complete.
variants: The pending request is for site Birch. Both the new signed order and its amendment name site Elm.
The pending request is for Birch. Two signed amendments with the same timestamp name different sites. Both have been uploaded and neither is marked current.
The pending request is for Birch. The current signed order also names Birch for the same service.

policy: The recorded allowance is six units per period. A new packet is required only when the requested units exceed the unused allowance. Reconcile disputed consumption before building. All other prerequisites are complete.
variants: Four units were consumed. The current order requests three more in this period.
One ledger shows four units consumed, the other shows two. Neither entry has been reconciled. Three more units are requested.
Three units were consumed. The current order requests exactly three more in this period.

policy: This queue handles Cedar plans only. If another plan is confirmed, close the local request and route it to that plan without packaging. Determine the current plan using a dated eligibility response. All other prerequisites for a Cedar request are complete.
variants: The eligibility response for the service date identifies Cedar. An old member card identifies Pine.
Eligibility has not returned for the service date. The referral carries last year's Cedar card.
Eligibility for the service date confirms Pine. The referral header still says Cedar.

policy: Only a current signed order with code K2 needs a packet. A current signed K1 order is exempt. If the current signed version cannot be determined, clarify before packaging. Other prerequisites are complete.
variants: Version 3 is current and signed, with K2. It supersedes signed version 2 with K1.
Two signed orders with K1 and K2 each claim to replace the other. Both are filed and neither has a revision date.
The current signed amendment changes K2 to K1. The encounter header still shows K2.
